description: Positive control figure: AllK detects carbamate kinase folds where AllF/AllG/AllH detect none
code:
import json, os, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
OUT=os.getcwd()
KW=re.compile(r"carbamate kinase|carbamoyl|transcarbamyl|acetylglutamate kinase|amino acid kinase|aspartokinase|NAGK", re.I)

def collect(res):
    h=[]
    for db in res["results"]:
        al=db["alignments"]; al=al[0] if al and isinstance(al[0],list) else al
        for a in (al or []):
            h.append(dict(db=db["db"],target=a["target"],eval=a["eval"],seqId=a.get("seqId")))
    return pd.DataFrame(h)

ctrl=collect(json.load(open(os.path.join(OUT,"foldseek_allK_control.json"))))
raw =json.load(open(os.path.join(OUT,"foldseek_raw.json")))
sub={}
for q in ["AllF","AllG","AllH"]:
    sub[q]=collect(raw[q])
sub["AllK (control)"]=ctrl

rows=[]
for q,df in sub.items():
    df=df[df.db.isin(["pdb100","cath50"])]
    kw=df[df.target.apply(lambda t: bool(KW.search(t)))]
    kwsig=kw[kw["eval"]<1e-3]
    rows.append(dict(subunit=q, n_aln=len(df), n_kw=len(kw), n_kw_sig=len(kwsig),
                     best_kw_eval=(kwsig["eval"].min() if len(kwsig) else np.nan)))
C=pd.DataFrame(rows)
C.to_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"table11_foldseek_positive_control.csv"),index=False)
print(C.to_string(index=False))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11,4.2))
x=np.arange(len(C)); col=["#4a6fa5","#4a6fa5","#4a6fa5","#c0532f"]
ax[0].bar(x,C.n_kw_sig,color=col)
ax[0].set_xticks(x); ax[0].set_xticklabels(C.subunit,rotation=15)
ax[0].set_ylabel("Foldseek hits to carbamoyl / carbamate-kinase\nfolds at E < 1e-3")
ax[0].set_title("Same pipeline, same keyword filter")
for i,v in enumerate(C.n_kw_sig): ax[0].text(i,v+0.7,str(v),ha="center",fontsize=10)

ev=C.best_kw_eval.values
neg=[-np.log10(e) if e==e else 0 for e in ev]
ax[1].bar(x,neg,color=col)
ax[1].set_xticks(x); ax[1].set_xticklabels(C.subunit,rotation=15)
ax[1].set_ylabel("-log10 best E-value of such a hit")
ax[1].set_title("AllK hits carbamate kinase at E = 4.9e-42;\nAllF, AllG and AllH have no such hit at all")
ax[1].axhline(3,ls="--",c="grey",lw=1); ax[1].text(0.02,3.3,"E = 1e-3",fontsize=8,color="grey")
plt.suptitle("Positive control for the fold-assignment negative result",fontsize=12)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
